description:
FILED s522a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-19) from the #3061 acceptance runs (Text-CSV-2.04 now transpiles t/util.pl).  SILENT WRONG, pre-existing (identical on the aff112d7 base extraction).

A HASH list-assignment through a deref of an ELEMENT does not autovivify the element; the ARRAY twin does:

    my $s = {}; %{$s->{C}} = (b => 2); print join(",", %{$s->{C}}), "\n";   # perl b,2   PCL (empty)
    my %h;      %{$h{C}}   = (e => 5); print join(",", %{$h{C}}), "\n";     # perl e,5   PCL (empty)
    my $u = {}; %{$u->{C}} = ();       print ref $u->{C}, "\n";             # perl HASH  PCL (empty)
    my $t = {}; @{$t->{C}} = (3);      print "@{$t->{C}}\n";               # perl 3     PCL 3 (right)
    my $c;      %$c = (a => 1);        # right (a plain scalar autovivifies)

EMISSION (the asymmetry IS the bug):
    %{$s->{C}} = …  ->  (p-hash-deref-=  (p-cast-% (p-gethash-deref     $s "C")) …)   ; a VALUE: nothing to vivify into
    @{$t->{C}} = …  ->  (p-array-deref-= (p-cast-@ (p-gethash-deref-box $t "C")) …)   ; a BOX: vivifies
The `%{ELEM}` lvalue operand must take the -box accessor the `@{ELEM}` one takes (Pl/ExprToCL.pm, the operand of p-cast-% in an assignment's LEFT side; grep the sibling that picks -deref-box for the @ cast -- rule 11: one predicate for both sigils).

IMPACT: Text::CSV_PP keeps its parse state as `%{$self->{_CACHE}} = %$ctx;` after every getline (lib/Text/CSV_PP.pm 1818 / 2238 / 2248 / 2999) and reloads it with `%$ctx = %{$self->{_CACHE}}`; the store is lost, so `recno` never advances (record_number stays 1 -- probe scratch/s522a/pr/csv2.pl: perl rn=1,2,3, PCL 1,1,1) and every record is parsed as if it were the first (the `sep=` header detection at 2662 tests `!$ctx->{recno}`).  Board rows behind it (blessed s522a with this cause): Text-CSV 68_header.t "done" x4 (record_number 1 vs 3), 22_scalario.t "sep= not on 1st line" + "error" (2012 vs 2023, probable); 12_acc.t row 126 `record_number` '1' '2' (blessed #966 + #1747) is very likely this too.  Minimal probe: scratch/s522a/pr/hs3.pl in the s522a worktree.

BAR: a guard row (the four shapes above), inverse-failing on the base; corpus-diff + emission-ab explained; the sweep (an emission change); Text-CSV one-file runs of 68_header.t / 22_scalario.t / 12_acc.t, their rows out by edit.


=== DONE (s523d, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-22, commit 78157e9d) ===
Pl/ExprToCL.pm: the `%` cast that is the DIRECT left side of `=` (its node id held in $self->{_hash_assign_lhs} while the LHS is generated) takes lvalue context, exactly the context the `@` twin always takes, so its operand emits the vivifying -box accessor: `%{$s->{C}} = …` -> (p-cast-% (p-gethash-deref-box $s "C")); `%{$h{C}}` -> p-gethash-box; `%{$r->[0]}` -> p-aref-deref-box; nested `%{$n->{a}{b}}` boxes both levels.  An rvalue `%{$h->{x}}` is untouched (still does not vivify -- perl agrees, probed).  Probe scratch/s523d/pr/hv.pl: all five shapes = perl 5.40.3; base prints empty.  Guard Pl/t/deref-vivify-01.t r43-r49 (inverse: base fails r43-47, r49).  Generation v2-8284 + the three artifacts (stamp only).  Found on the way: perl's `keys %{$h->{missing}}` DOES vivify (the #753 comment said the opposite) -> filed #3720, comment corrected.
Text-CSV one-file runs (scratch/s523d/csv/*.m2, after #3611 + #3612): 68_header 32/0, 77_getall 81/0, 79_callbacks 113/0 (all blessed #3611 rows out); 85_util 1346/102 (the 144 #3611 rows AND #3617's 10 header() rows pass -- #3617 was this mechanism); 80_diag 330/15 ran 345 of 345 (25 #3611 rows + the *PLAN* row out); 22_scalario 2 rows out; 20_file / 22_scalario rows 2 31 106-109 still fail = the binary-character-with-binary-off family the 80_diag rows 53-57 / 93-102 carry (#1389), re-caused by edit.
subject: SILENT WRONG: %{$h->{k}} = LIST does not autovivify the element (emits p-gethash-deref, the @{...} twin emits -deref-box) -- Text::CSV_PP loses its parse state after every getline (record_number stuck at 1)
